1927, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 39 Cont.
Nov. 22 Mrs. Mary Ross 59 of Brown City, dying of Cancer of stomach was enrolled May 5th. At once she began to improve. Doctors had neglected her and consequently her digestion was so bad that for that reason she had to go to hospital In five weeks she was home in perfect health. Not yet Catholic. Mar. 30, 1931 Still in perfect health.
Dec. 3 Edward Zitnik 2 of 62 Henry St. River Rouge paralized, enrolled Oct. 28th after doctors had expressed hope of his possible walking in four months. Comes To-day in perfect condition - next day after enrollment asked to be loosed from brace and walk.
Dec. Patricia Irine Mohler 8 months 591 Navanoe, Detroit, beautiful child, without any power in her back, though seemingly perfectly formed - eyes too are beautiful but out of controll and sight doubtful. Father not Catholic
Dec. 29th reported hopelessly dying. Enrolled again
1928
1928, January
Jan. 3rd Tuesday. Diphtheria & Double Quinsy Cured over phone. (From Jos F. Droste's letter) "1-2-128 . . You will remember that about noon last Wednesday Dec. 28th I called you by phone ..... Mrs. Droste was at the point of death, suffering from a severe case of diphtheria combined with double quinsy. The doctor held very little hope of re- covery . He was almost certain that death would occur before mid- night. . . Thank God .. ... about 7 o'clock Wednesday evening she was relieved and ate a small amount of food. - The quinsy just disapeared .... She is now on her feet and doing well .. = "Again on Friday evening Dec. 30th at about 9 o'clock P.M. I called you for prayers for my Daughter Mildred who was dying of Diptheria. .... "You assured me we would have a happy New Year."

Jan. 9th- Fifty annual Enrollments 15th
March 2nd Property Saved. Charles O'Brien, Roseland Ont. with wife and five small children borrows small amt to hold off mortgage of less than 5000 A Jew seems to have laid scheem to get property by paying the mortgage and a few thousand dollars over .....
